# SOURCE
## app.roc
~~~roc
app [main] { pf: platform "./platform.roc" }

main : I64
main = add(3, 4) * 2

add : I64, I64 -> I64
add = |a, b| a + b
~~~
## platform.roc
~~~roc
platform ""
    requires {} { main : I64 }
    exposes []
    packages {}
    provides { "roc_main": main_for_host }
    targets: {
        inputs_dir: "targets/",
        x64glibc: { inputs: [app] },
    }

main_for_host : I64
main_for_host = main
~~~
